io.webagent4j.policy.IExecutionPolicy

Packages that use IExecutionPolicy
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action.policy
Action authorization: IActionPolicy governs whether one action's backend side effect may proceed, evaluated by the action pipeline strictly before the backend is ever invoked.
io.webagent4j.policy
Generic, synchronous execution-policy contracts shared across WebAgent4J modules.
io.webagent4j.policy.network
Network-destination governance: INetworkPolicy decides whether WebAgent4J may make a network request to a given destination, evaluated strictly before the request is sent.
